review.landing: Old tall, medium and slender fir stickers bake rooted plants and rocks into the tree. Replaced at two valley stops with separate trunk, rear crown, near bough, boulder, seed grass and buttercup cards.
review.next_cove: Split old bank clusters into bank surface, independently rooted cattails, foreground reeds and separate stones. Keep fish, boat and wake independently masked to water. Existing panorama remains original.
review.next_grove: Preserve standalone fruit, plants and basket. Separate bed rear wall, soil and near lip when reblocking the grove.
review.next_bridge: Keep the existing separate rope and shell parts. Revisit the deck, abutments and bank contacts together when redesigning the crossing.
